page: monitor/baseline/ (pipeline infrastructure, not a dome-site change)
description: PIPELINE-HEALTH finding: monitor/baseline/ is genuinely stale on this session's FUSE mount, not just directory-listing-stale (per the CLAUDE.md 'transient mount-view staleness' pattern). A directory listing of monitor/baseline/ via the FUSE workspace showed only 7 files (01-home.txt through 07-ai-context.txt), but the GitHub git tree at HEAD has 10 baseline files (08-killshot.txt, 09-audit.txt, 10-review-response.txt are missing from the FUSE view entirely) and config.json's git-HEAD copy correctly lists all 10 target pages including killshot/audit/review-response (added via commit history, exact commit not identified this poll). Worse: monitor/baseline/07-ai-context.txt on FUSE is not just absent-from-listing but CONTENT-STALE -- it is 9,379 bytes and its content is a GitHub Pages 404 'Page not found' stub (the PRE-FIX baseline, from before config.json's ai-context URL bug -- '/ai-context' vs the correct '/context' -- was corrected). The git-HEAD version of the same file (reseeded by commit b80c1c02, analyst-baby EXP-666, 2026-07-13T03:35:25Z, 11 days before this poll) is 32,918 bytes of real AI Context Archive page content, md5 430ddcd4eb75369d0f38583e750e633c. This poller run worked around the gap by fetching monitor/config.json and all 10 monitor/baseline/*.txt files directly from the GitHub raw API (git-authoritative per CLAUDE.md FUSE Staleness Warning) rather than trusting the FUSE Read/ls views, and confirmed all 10 live dome pages are byte-identical to the git-authoritative baselines (see chg-20260724-0011-00{1,2,3} and the NET QUIET poll summary). Root cause not investigated (out of poller's scope/time budget) -- plausibly the same git->FUSE propagation-lag class covered by dome-mirror/workspace-sync Step 4c, but 11 days is well beyond the documented max propagation windows (hourly to ~8h in quiet-period cadence), so this may be a distinct gap specific to monitor/baseline/ (not on any OWNERSHIP/NEVER_PUSH list checked this run) or a per-file sync miss. Recommend tinker verify whether monitor/baseline/ is covered by dome-mirror's git->FUSE sync scope, and whether other monitor/ subdirectories have similar undetected staleness.
before: Unknown -- staleness may have existed since 2026-07-13 (11 days) without being surfaced in a poll record before this run.
after: monitor/baseline/ confirmed 3-files-missing + 1-file-content-stale on this session's FUSE mount vs. git HEAD. Poller used git-fetched baselines for this cycle's comparison; live dome pages confirmed unchanged either way.
